_comment: Numbers deliberately not from the run their surrounding text cites, and provenance labels with the condition that retires each. Every entry needs a reason a reader can evaluate. Adding an entry to silence the checker rather than to record a fact is the one way this file makes things worse than no file.
_ratchetNote: 70 when the check was switched on; 24 after the taxonomy write-up added two correct run citations to EVALUATION_RELIABILITY_PLAN.md; 22 after §2.4's generated-bank section was given the run its own figures come from (33254598308) instead of inheriting the injection-benchmark run cited above it, and the 93.8% intermediate in that section was declared local; 15 after the README was re-derived against run 33419076907 (the CI run for the current commit) and its still-current tables -- the generated bank's after-column, the interval table, and the injection benchmark -- were given that run as their citation instead of inheriting an older one. Each drop is the mechanism working rather than a fix: the doc attributed everything below a citation to that citation, so citing the right run mid-document re-attributes many figures at once. The remaining 15 are the same structural problem further up, and the checker names the correct run for each, so the work is mechanical. README's own 3 are genuinely historical -- two 'before' columns and one figure quoted inside a correction as an example of a wrong number -- and are the case this ratchet exists to leave alone rather than to launder. Lower this as they are fixed; never raise it to go green. Unchanged by the approval/egress work: the figures that branch added were measured locally on the commit and are declared inline with `figures: local` markers plus the two provenance labels registered below, rather than being attributed to a run that does not contain them.
_uncitedRatchetNote: Figures that cite no run anywhere in their document. Reported since the check was written but, until now, unable to fail it -- which left the gate with a door in it: a fabricated number passed by citing nothing, and citing nothing is easier than citing wrongly. Ratcheted separately from unexplainedRatchet on purpose, so fixing an old misattribution cannot silently make room for a new uncited number. The 17 are pre-existing and concentrated in two documents this PR does not touch: docs/POLICY_EVALUATION.md (15 -- it cites no run at all) and docs/THREAT_MODEL.md (2). Resolve one by citing its run, wrapping the block in a `figures: local` marker with a reason, or registering it below.

figures.reason: Historical before-column of the bank-widening table. It is the detection rate that existed after the wrapper axis was widened and before the fix landed, so it appears in no CI run: no build was ever committed in that state. Attributed in the table itself as a before column.

Stated in the text as measured locally and never committed, describing a rejected first fix that regressed core detection. The sentence says so outright; it appears in no run because that fix was never pushed.

provenanceLabels.marker: Measured by running the named CLI on this commit on a developer machine
provenanceLabels.action: Re-derive the 'Evidence at this commit' table against that CI run, cite the run beside it, and remove this label and its figures: local marker.

provenanceLabels.marker: Re-measured by running npm run bench:injection on this commit on a developer machine
provenanceLabels.action: Re-derive the injection-benchmark residual figures (3,714/3,750, the carrier-class strata) against that CI run, cite it, and remove this label and its figures: local marker.

provenanceLabels.marker: Two local runs of the policy latency benchmark on this commit
provenanceLabels.action: Replace the two locally measured latency spreads with the CI run's figures, cite the run, and remove this label and its figures: local marker.

provenanceLabels.marker: Re-measured on the merged commit on a developer machine because the row above it had gone stale
provenanceLabels.action: Re-derive the Windows failure counts from that run's windows leg, cite it, and remove this label and its figures: local marker. The stored baseline in .github/windows-baseline.json is the gate; this label only covers the prose copy of the number.

_provenanceLabelSchema._howToUse: Register EVERY provenance label here - 'measured locally', 'pending CI', 'preliminary', 'from a dev machine'. A label is a claim with an expiry date; this is where the expiry lives. The checker fails when a condition is met, because from that moment the label reads as current and is not.
_provenanceLabelSchema._workedExample: The mechanism was built from, and validated against, a real case: README carried 'measured locally, not from CI - refresh once the harness lands'. It was accurate when written and false about ten hours later when that branch's CI ran. Nothing was edited; the world moved. Run against the commit that still carried it, the checker reports EXPIRED and names run 33354116107 as the one that retired it. That entry is now resolved and removed.

example.marker: verbatim substring that identifies the label in the document
example.action: what to do when it expires
